task.title: Stop Subscription Auto-Renewal
task.shortdesc: Learn how to disable auto-renewal for an active paid subscription.

context.p: Use this procedure for a paid subscription that was purchased through Verifone and currently has auto-renewal enabled.

step.cmd: Click Stop Auto-renewal in the Subscription Status section.
The system disables auto-renewal for the subscription.
Confirm that the button is no longer displayed and that the subscription status reflects the change.
Renew the subscription manually before the expiration date if you want to continue using the service.

postreq.note: Once disabled, you can re-enable auto-renewal from your Verifone account management interface.
If you delete the organization while auto-renewal is enabled, the system disables auto-renewal as part of the deletion process.
